adjudication.rationale: The diff substantially rewrites the public `GroupsController#members` action: it now applies `limit`/`offset` for all groups (default 50), computes `total = group.users.count`, and returns a new JSON envelope `{members: ..., meta: {total, limit, offset}}` instead of `render_serialized(members.to_a, ...)` (see `app/controllers/groups_controller.rb`). The client-side `Discourse.Group#findMembers` was updated to consume `result.meta.*` and set `members` accordingly, and templates now iterate `{{#each m in members}}` rather than `model` (`group/members.hbs`). However, the only added/modified specs in this diff are for `Admin::GroupsController` (`spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb`); there is no spec exercising the new public members response shape or default/pagination behavior, so regressions in `meta.total/limit/offset` or the default 50 would not be caught by these tests.
